[[File:Coif_chathead.png|left]]
A '''coif''' is an improved [[cowl]] that requires 20 [[Ranged]] to equip. Coifs are the best ranged headgear available for free to play. It can be made by members at level 38 [[Crafting]] with one [[leather]] (soft), a [[needle]], and [[thread]]. 

Making a coif in the [[Lumbridge cow field]] is a requirement for the [[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary|medium Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]].
